items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: Mickey Roker is listed as a signer of the award in the interviewer's description, but the interviewee does not mention him or describe any personal interaction.

ctx.x: He'd do a lot of that, press rolls. Like Big Sid Catlett would do a lot of press rolls. Cozy Cole did a lot of it, too. Baby Dodds did a lot of press rolling. Zutty Singleton did a lot of press rolling. And you had drummers in different... Most of them were different style of drummers...

Freddie Moore is showing us "The Professional Percussion Center Presents The Gene Krupa Award to Zutty Singleton, July 2nd, 1974." And you are... One of the signers of this award is Fred Moore. Grady Tate is also a signer, Mickey Roker, Baby Lovett, Sam Unio(?), Ray McKenzie, Roy Eldridge, Terry Clarke, Stanley Kaye... Uh-huh! Okay.
